targeted_correction_prompts.bear: Edit this exact bear image. Change ONLY BOTH HANDS and BOTH FEET; keep the face, body, pose of torso, costume, prayer beads, armor, background and framing unchanged. Correct the finger and toe counts so left and right match. BOTH hands must be visibly OPEN, with the palms rotated FORWARD to face the viewer, NOT curled inward as in the input. Show FIVE fully separated COUNTABLE fingers on EACH hand: four upright/descending relaxed fingers and one opposing thumb, each with a single small dark claw. No fingertips may hide behind another finger. Keep chunky bear paw anatomy and believable wrist attachment. BOTH feet must have FIVE COUNTABLE exposed forward-facing toe mounds and FIVE dark claws on EACH foot, ten foot toes total: currently only four toes are drawn on each foot; replace each four-toe fan with a wider five-toe fan, adding a clearly separated small fifth outer toe rather than a duplicate claw on an existing toe. All five toes must be fully outside the front sandal strap and individually visible in the front view. Match foot toe widths, spacing and corresponding claw shapes between sides. Do not retain the old four-toe silhouette. This is a focused anatomical correction, not a redesign. No text, inset views, weapons, extra limbs or extra appendages.
targeted_correction_prompts.fox_and_falcon: Focused anatomical edit of this exact concept image. Change ONLY the pose and drawing of BOTH GLOVED HANDS; keep everything else unchanged, including feet, toe count, face, clothing, armor, wings/tails, lighting and overall composition. Rotate BOTH palms forward toward the viewer and gently OPEN the hands rather than curling the fingers inward. Show exactly FIVE fully separated countable digits on each hand, ten in total: one opposed thumb placed laterally away from the body and four relaxed gently splayed fingers pointing generally downwards. Index, middle, ring and little fingers have natural distinct lengths mirrored correctly between left and right hands. All five fingertips on each hand must be entirely visible with light-background gaps between them; no finger hides behind another. Keep the dark leather gloves, precise glove seam and joint articulation details, normal stylized humanoid palm anatomy, appropriately narrow wrist, coherent wrist-to-bracer connection, and existing hand size. No claws or animal paw pads on these leather gloves, no sixth digit, no duplicated thumb, no merged or broken finger. Keep both hands in approximately their current positions, slightly away from hips. Do not change the feet or any other design element. Full-body front concept image, no inset images, labels, extra limbs or weapons.

review_scope: Manual visual review of the final front concept images: visible hand digits, exposed foot toes/claws, mirrored footwear structure, limb joints and retained tails/wings. Concept image review does not certify future model topology, skinning or firearm grip deformation.

requirements.falcon_footwear: matching closed boots, no exposed toes
requirements.pose: front-facing concept presentation, visible hands and feet, not T-pose

heroes.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied player hero concept. Preserve this exact character identity, face, species, major silhouette, palette, costume theme and signature appendages. Refine the same design with MORE purposeful game-art detail: readable garment folds, seam edging, leather panel construction, modest stitching, strap attachment points, buckles, bevels on armor edges and restrained wear. Keep Gunfire Reborn-compatible hand-painted stylized art, broad matte color masses and clear angular volume planes, but less uniformly triangulated cardboard appearance. No photorealism, glossy rendering, micro-noise, extra jewelry, random decorations or excessive complexity. Critical anatomical correction: EXACTLY TWO arms and TWO legs. Match left and right upper-arm/forearm lengths, palm widths and finger proportions; believable continuous shoulder-elbow-wrist and hip-knee-ankle structure. Show actual elbow and wrist narrowing; bracers end above the wrist and do not merge into the palm. Both hands clearly visible, gently open with palms mostly facing the camera and fingers lightly separated, EVERY digit countable: EXACTLY FIVE fingers on each hand consisting of ONE anatomically opposed thumb plus FOUR fingers (index, middle, ring, little), ten fingers total. Thumb is a separate two-segment digit attached low on the palm; four fingers have readable knuckles and natural differing lengths mirrored between hands. NO extra fingertip, duplicated thumb, fused fingers, hidden fingers, mitten shape or mismatched hands. Hands contain no weapon. Resting presentation pose with arms held only 20 degrees away from the body so hands do not overlap clothing; not T-pose, not a turnaround. Direct FRONT-facing full-body view, pelvis square to camera, level shoulders, straight stable legs, both feet point directly forward with identical visible construction, no foreshortening. Single hero, head to toes completely in frame, large portrait composition on plain light warm gray background, even soft light, no labels/text/grids, no supporting detail panels. The image must make left/right limbs easy to compare. Female red fox ranger: preserve orange fur, cream muzzle and chest, vermilion scarf/waist panel, brown leather armor, indigo trousers and red-wrapped dark leather bracers. Dark brown five-finger gloves with clear individual finger sections and visible clean edges against background. Feet are fox hind paws in open-toe boot cuffs: EXACTLY FOUR distinct toe mounds and FOUR short matching claws on EACH foot, eight toes and eight claws total. Match left/right toe width, spacing, size sequence, claw placement, cuff height and bandage wrap construction. View all four toes on each foot directly from front, fully exposed and separated. Preserve EXACTLY THREE cream-tipped orange tails in the established asymmetric arrangement: one large tail to viewer-left, one large tail to upper viewer-right and a third tail curling toward lower viewer-right. Do not add a fourth tail. Tails remain behind hips and clear of hands.
